verses.text: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
lines: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh.

verses.text: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
lines: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips,

verses.text: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
lines: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you,

verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
lines: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech,
that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

verses.text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
lines: My soul has had her dwelling too long

verses.text: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
lines: but when I speak, they are for war.
